accounts_dir.description: Directory where OfflineIMAP stores account metadata and status.

maxsyncaccounts.description: Maximum number of accounts to sync concurrently. Set to 1 for strict sequential sync.

ui.description: User interface mode. Use 'Basic' for terminal UI, 'TUI' for text-mode interface, or 'Quiet' for cron/daemon use.

showmailstats.description: Whether to display mail statistics (e.g., synced message counts) in non-interactive UI.

logdir.description: Directory to write log files. If omitted, logging is disabled.

logfile.description: Full path to log file. Only used if `logdir` is specified.

accounts.description: List of IMAP accounts to synchronize.

name.description: Unique identifier for this account (used in section headers).

remote_port.description: Port for IMAP connection (993 for SSL, 143 for non-SSL).

remote_pass.description: Password for IMAP login. Prefer using `remote_pass_command` for security.

remote_pass_command.description: Shell command that outputs the IMAP password (e.g., 'pass email/gmail'). Safer than plain password.

remote_ssl.description: Enable SSL/TLS for the remote IMAP connection.

ssl_verify.description: SSL certificate verification mode. 'cert' verifies host certificate; 'none' disables verification (not recommended).

ssl_ca_path.description: Path to directory containing trusted CA certificates (for OpenSSL).

ssl_ca_file.description: Path to file containing trusted CA certificates (PEM format).

local_path.description: Local Maildir root directory for this account (e.g., ~/Mail/Personal).

autosync.description: Enable automatic bidirectional sync. If false, manual sync only.

expunge.description: Permanently remove messages marked for deletion on both sides. Enable only if you understand the risk.

maxaccountsyncs.description: Per-account override for max sync threads. If omitted, uses global `maxsyncaccounts`.
